cd $TMPDIR/lingen/handoff && for f in *.py; do sed -n "s/.*b64decode('\(.*\)').*/\1/p" "$f" | base64 -d | tr '|' '\n' | awk -v f="$f" '{i=index($0,"="); print f "\t" substr($0,1,i-1) "\t" substr($0,i+1)}'; done | awk -F'\t' '$2=="campaign_id"{n=split($3,p,"-"); T[$1]=tolower(p[n])} $2=="url"{U[$1]=$3}
 END{for(f in U){h=U[f]; sub(/^[a-z]+:\/\//,"",h); sub(/\..*/,"",h); n=split(h,q,"-"); if(tolower(q[n])!=T[f]) print f}}' | sort | head -1
